content.introduction: Bitcoin briefly topped $80,000, the highest level since late January, as it jumped overnight by as much as 2%. This surge was attributed to President Trump's announcement of "Project Freedom" and developments on the war in the Middle East according to Yahoo Finance. Another source from TradingView indicated that the rally was fueled by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission's (CFTC) filing of new crypto proposals. However, CNBC reported a different context, noting that Bitcoin surged past the $80,000 mark on Tuesday due to renewed inflows into spot bitcoin ETFs and improving risk appetite.

The token jumped as much as 2% on Sunday night after President Trump announced "Project Freedom," an initiative designed to provide safe passage for neutral international ships currently trapped in the Strait of Hormuz due to the US-Iran war.

What else you need to know: Bitcoin jumped 12% in April, its strongest monthly gain since May of last year.

# Bitcoin briefly tops $80,000, the highest level since January

Ines Ferré

Ines Ferré  · Senior Business Reporter

1 min read

 BTC-USD
 GC=F

What happened: Bitcoin (BTC-USD) jumped overnight, briefly topping $80,000, its highest level since late January.

What's behind the move: The world's largest cryptocurrency came off January highs as traders digested the latest developments on the war in the Middle East.

The overall cryptocurrency market jumped 2% higher to just under $2.8 trillion. CoinGlass data showed that nearly $490 million in crypto bets had been liquidated in the last 24 hours, with $250 million wiped out in the past hour alone. Shorts led the bleed with $431 million underwater. [...] The filing follows the blocking of the Clarity Act in a Senate procedural vote earlier this week, which dragged Bitcoin’s price down to below $75,000 on Tuesday.

Bitcoin Reclaims $80K As Crypto Market Rebounds

Bitcoin’s price climbed over 4% to $80,800, making it the top-trending cryptocurrency on Stocktwits at the time of writing. Retail sentiment around the apex cryptocurrency, however, remained in ‘bearish’ territory over the past day. [...] Bitcoin’s (BTC) price climbed back over $80,000 on Friday morning, for the first time in over a week, with Hyperliquid (HYPE) and Solana (SOL) leading gains among crypto majors.

The rally came after the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) filed two new proposals, the Regulation Crypto Asset Transactions and the Regulation Crypto Asset Markets, with the White House's Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs (OIRA) for review.

Bitcoin surged past the $80,000 mark on Tuesday, as renewed inflows into spot bitcoin ETFs and improving risk appetite extended the cryptocurrency’s recent rally.

The flagship cryptocurrency last jumped over 2% to $80,501.
